articles.summary: If you're not following eval-driven development, you're flying blind. Sohan and Marcel on Tusk's founding team reveal how we use lightweight evals to ship fast improvements to our AI product with confidence.

articles.title: TeamFeePay Increases Unit Test Coverage 30% in 3 Weeks
